items.name: Albanian Open 2018
items.information:
First WCA competition in Albania.

The competition will also be positioned as Albanian National Championship 2018. So fastest Albanian competitors per event will be honoured as national champions.

Two weeks before the competition, registered competitors will be requested by email to confirm their participation. Registered competitors must reply at least three days before the competition, otherwise they may be removed from the competitor list.

On-site registration is possible until 12:30pm in the venue.

items.name: Friends & Cubes SC 2018

venue.name: Gimnasio Universitario de los Módulos de la UAGRM
venue.details: Gimnasio al fondo de la parte de los módulos como de ida al 3er anillo

items.information:
El torneo se llevara a cabo en el ginmasio de los modulos de la UAGRM, ubicado en la parte final de los modulos (si vamos de 2do a 3er anillo) 
El costo de inscripcion sera de 40 bs precio base y 5 bs por cada categoria (Por ej, 45 bs si se compite en una categoria) 
Con cada competencia estamos cada vez mas estrictos con el periodo de inscripcion, ya para el anterior torneo, varios se quedaron sin participar por no pagar a tiempo asi que por favor realizar el pago correspondiente A TIEMPO. 
Ver las pestañas PAGOS Y POLERAS para ver la informacion acerca como confirmar su participacion y tener la oportunidad de tener poleras del torneo.
NOTA:
Ver la pestaña EVENTO ESPECIAL para tener informacion acerca del pequeño evento que tendra el torneo.

items.name: Utah Spring Open 2018

venue.name: [University of Utah Union Building Saltair Room](http://union.utah.edu/rooms/saltair-room/)
venue.address: 200 Central Campus Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84112
venue.details: On the main floor in the room behind the trophy case.

items.information:
Cubes will be sold at the competition by Olliver's Twisted Puzzles. 
There is a 110 person competitor limit, so don't wait too long to register.
Only food from the University of Utah is allowed in the room.
In the floor underneath the venue's floor there is a food court along with some vending machines.
The parking lot right by the Union Building will be free the day of the event.
Registration is online only.  Registration will not be accepted at the door.
Registration is not considered complete until payment has been recieved.
As always, make sure you are familiar with all the regulations.

items.name: CubeIowa 2018
items.information:
There is a 150 Person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please register early to ensure a spot on the competitor list. 
This competition is on and indoor soccer field! While we will have plenty of chairs and tables, feel free to bring your lawn chairs and blankets, and enjoy the amazing space we have!


Food-
The venue will offer lunch and snacks at it's concession stand. You can also eat any food you have with you at the concessions area. If you don't wish to eat there, Ames has plenty of food options, most within a 10 minute drive of the venue.
*FOOD WILL NOT BE ALLOWED ON THE TURF OF THE FIELD, ONLY CLOSED LID DRINKS.*
